decisions.reason: The exact chemical-element mercury meaning is explicit and appropriate to the academic anchor; retain uncountable usage without inventing preferred nomenclature.
The hydrochloric-acid compound with an organic base is a specific chemistry meaning; it is not a generic replacement for every chloride.
Any hydrogen cation, with a proton as the source's example, is a precise academic chemistry meaning; do not equate all isotopic hydrons with one proton species.
The medical excess-blood meaning is verified but the sole TOEIC congestion anchor does not establish a medical rather than traffic context for this specialist.
The definition correctly specifies the product of consecutive integers each to its own power; reject the old inaccurate product-of-factorials connection.
Unusually high blood sugar is explicitly sourced and relevant to diabetes health vocabulary; do not equate the measurement state with a disease diagnosis.
The very-cold physical state supports chill vocabulary; the separate emotional lack-of-affection meaning is not selected.
Something serving as a light source is self-contained and supports lamp and lighting equipment study.
No exact plural source sense or reviewed illustration mapping is available; the proposed drawn-image meaning remains without attributable entry evidence.
The available sculptor and disk-image system senses do not verify the intended camera or image-sensor meaning; avoid publishing a different technical homonym.
The sole entry refers to the unexplained literary movement imagism, not general photographic imagery; the proposed broad visual meaning is unverified.
Liquid absorption by a solid or gel is explicit and appropriate to chemistry; exclude business absorption and the separate drinking sense.
Being spotlessly clean is self-contained and fits cleanliness; the word need not describe moral or abstract perfection.
Select the figurative deeply-involved meaning appropriate to task engagement; preserve its figurative label and distinguish literal submersion.
Liable to happen immediately or very soon is explicitly defined; an adverse threat is not required.
The immune-response substance is a specialist biology category, not a general synonym for the business-list vaccine anchor; appropriate teaching scope is unresolved.
The source explains antibody glycoproteins and their immune role, providing a complete academic meaning rather than a mere formal synonym assertion.
Being about to happen or threatening to happen is explicit and relevant to looming business events; retain intransitive usage.
The commanding-manner definition supplies a clear communication meaning; it is not interchangeable with every urgent action.
Fixing firmly or setting securely or deeply is the broad verb supported by embed; no surgical procedure or travel-company occupation is inferred.
Not easy to believe is a direct meaning appropriate to credibility assessment, unlike merely using incredibly as an intensifier.
The merchandise tax, tariff or duty meaning supports levy; retain the historical label and do not import architectural or horse-racing senses.
Wishing harm upon someone is explicit and related to cursing; it is distinct from making an oath or all ordinary swear-word use.
Strength to withstand attack is self-contained and relevant to defensive safety, without promising absolute protection in real situations.
Cutting into with a sharp instrument, carving or engraving is explicit; restrict to academic physical-cutting contexts rather than pricing or fitness slash homonyms.
The source only says relating to an incision and does not verify the proposed contrast about how much tissue is removed; clearer learner-facing evidence is needed.
An instance or point of disagreement is a self-contained sense relevant to discrepancy; oddness and illogicality are not mandatory in every use.
The quality of being vague or poorly defined is explicit and fits uncertainty without requiring a prediction about future outcomes.
Adjusting an economic variable according to an index is a precise business meaning; do not promote the misleading physical-escalator connection or invent list membership.
Modifying something to suit an individual directly supports personalization; retain the source's spelling labels unchanged.
No exact plural source sense or reviewed individual mapping is available; the familiar people meaning still requires recorded factual evidence.
The conducting-coil electrical device introducing inductance is explicit and appropriate to circuits, not every kind of reactor.
The socioeconomic system based on industrial manufacturing is self-contained and distinct from the process of industrialization.
Lacking the power to be effective is a clear outcome-focused meaning; it does not necessarily imply waste of resources or lack of skill.
The condition of being ineffective is explicit and understandable, supporting the distinction between obtaining no result and mere inefficiency.
By necessity is an explicit equivalent appropriate to necessarily, without inventing a mandatory philosophical register.
The joined phrase lacks an exact sourced entry or reviewed spaced-phrase mapping; the old academic gloss is not sufficient evidence.
The precise thigh-to-trunk junction and adjacent region is sourced and relevant to groin anatomy; no clinical superiority claim is added.
No exact plural entry or reviewed inhabitant mapping is present; preserve hidden until the intended resident sense has attributable evidence.
Being an essential or intrinsic part is fully explained; retain the uncommon label and do not equate it with every sense of consist.
